Kiyesi 0.1.0 · read-only scan · full report
checkout-api-prod · Ubuntu 22.04 · 22 checks in 6.4 s
Scanned on Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 10:45 UTC, as root

GRADE  D  55/100     2 critical · 3 warnings · 17 passed

CRITICAL
 FAIL  Redis is open to the internet on port 6379 · likely
       Why: Anyone can connect and read or wipe the data. A cloud firewall
            outside the server cannot be seen from here, so this is likely,
            not confirmed.
       Fix: bind the port to 127.0.0.1 in docker-compose.yml, then
            docker compose up -d redis

 FAIL  The node process was killed for using too much memory at 10:41
       Why: This server has 1 GB of memory and no swap, so one spike takes
            the app down.
       Fix: sudo fallocate -l 1G /swapfile && sudo chmod 600 /swapfile &&
            sudo mkswap /swapfile && sudo swapon /swapfile &&
            echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab

WARNING
 WARN  SSL certificate for api.example.com expires in 9 days
       Why: When it expires, browsers and apps will refuse to connect.
       Fix: sudo certbot renew

 WARN  SSH allows password login
       Why: Passwords can be guessed by automated attacks. Keys cannot. Check
            that your key works before you turn passwords off.
       Fix: echo "PasswordAuthentication no" |
            sudo tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-kiyesi-no-password.conf &&
            sudo systemctl reload ssh

 WARN  Newest backup is 31 hours old
       Why: Backups are expected every 24 hours. The last one was written on
            Wed 7 Oct at 04:00.
       Fix: Find the job that writes it: sudo grep -ril backup /etc/cron*
            /var/spool/cron 2>/dev/null, and systemctl list-timers --all |
            grep -i backup
